symptom: UDP traffic relayed through the node gets slow and uses high CPU when many clients send packets at the same time, with throughput degrading as client count grows.
API requests that look up names regardless of letter case use more CPU and memory than expected and respond slowly, especially when the underlying lists are large.
Awarding badges and loading the notifications list feel slow and put heavy load on the database, especially for users with many badges and notifications.
The project list page loads slowly and hammers the database when many projects are managed from Git, with load time growing with the number of projects.
Judging a submission against the official test cases takes a long time, especially when a problem has many test cases to run.
Requesting an evolution chain from the API is slow and causes many database queries, especially for chains with many branching species such as Eevee.
Refreshing feeds puts heavy load on the database and takes a long time, especially for feeds with many entries or when many feeds refresh.
Computing a storage or power schedule spends a surprisingly long time checking device constraints, and it gets slower as the number of devices grows.
The status dashboard page takes many seconds to load and the database server shows high CPU when many past results are stored for each endpoint.
Opening the analytics tool-usage panel takes tens of seconds and freezes the whole server while it loads, when the activity history table is very large.
